goal: Traceability review: each requirement links to its code, its tests and its approval.
use: Traceability review: each requirement links to its code, its tests and its approval. Use when requirements must be shown to be built and tested.

steps.note: List requirements. Collect the numbered requirements.
Link code. Find the code that implements each requirement.
Link tests. Find the test that checks each requirement.
Find orphans. Flag code or tests that map to no requirement.
Report. A matrix of requirement, code, test and gaps.
